objective.statement: Make the torus in the torus widget (rendered on HomeView.tsx) 6 pixels in width.

complexity.rationale: One presentational component and its component test; no state, API or dependency change.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: The torus ring (its band, from inner to outer edge) renders 6 pixels wide, measured at the rendered size, with the 150px outer diameter kept.
The torus stays blue, keeps its gradient, and the widget stays no bigger than 200px by 200px; the label is unchanged.

in.statement: TorusWidget.tsx torus geometry and its component test; the widget is rendered by HomeView.tsx.

out.statement: Torus colour, widget size, label text, HomeView layout, dependencies, and historical workflow records.

observations.statement: Owner answer to q1: "6 pixels in width" means the ring thickness is 6px, keeping the 150px outer diameter.
Today the svg is 150px with viewBox 100, so scale is 1.5; outer radius 46 and inner radius 20 give a ring about 39px wide. A 6px ring needs a 4-unit band, so inner radius 42.

provenance.source: Card text: New Feature Make the torus narrower
Owner answer q1: Ring thickness is 6px; keep the 150px outer diameter
Conservative planning decision by the delivery engineer
Executor instruction: plan approval required before any work starts

approvals.requirement: The owner must approve this plan before any test or production file is written.

decisions.rationale: Plan saved at the planned gate; awaiting owner approval.

component.rationale: The rendered torus geometry is the behaviour under change.

integration.rationale: HomeView only mounts the widget; existing HomeView test still covers that.

e2e.rationale: Static visual size change with no user flow.

increments.behavior: The torus ring renders 6px wide at its rendered size.
increments.doneWhen: TorusWidget component test for the 6px ring width passes, and the existing widget tests still pass.

tests.description: TorusWidget exposes the torus ring width on the torus element as 6 (px) and the ring path inner radius yields a 6px band at the rendered scale.

expectedRedEvidence.expectedFailure: Expected ring width 6 but received about 39 with the current 46/20 radii.
